A little about me

Technical thinking.
Creative expression.

I graduated in Software Engineering from Middle East University with a “Very Good” GPA rating. My interests connect web and mobile development with visual design.

My projects range from interactive websites to a Disaster Management graduation project with Flutter, React, and a Spring Boot API. I enjoy connecting the interface people see with the logic that makes it work.

I also joined the media section at JUST Programming Chapter as a freelance graphic designer and video editor. That creative perspective shapes the way I approach digital experiences.
